task: Restore Instructor ability to archive documents (Academic Paper, Academic Journal) and scan via OCR model to automatically fill metadata fields linked to /archive

changes.server/middleware/fileValidation.js: Updated validateDualArchiveFiles to require at least one document (academicPaperFile OR academicJournalFile OR both) with strict MIME and size checks.
Updated bulkUploadArchive to allow either file or both, extracting metadata from the available file buffer and saving submissions accordingly.
changes.server/tests/integration/projects.test.j: Added test cases for single academic paper, single academic journal, both files, and neither file.
changes.client/src/pages/archive/ArchiveSearchPa: Added 'Archive Documents (OCR)' header button and empty-state call-to-action button for instructors linking to /archive/upload/capstone.
Added unit tests verifying instructor OCR button visibility and navigation.
changes.client/src/pages/archive/ExistingCapston: Added Back to Archive navigation, dedicated auto-extract and rescan buttons on both Academic Paper and Academic Journal cards, and updated per-field rescan to work with either file.
Added 5 comprehensive unit tests for OCR extraction on journal, paper, and bundle upload.

runbook.lesson: Instructors often archive legacy manuscripts where only an academic journal or condensed paper is available without the 5-chapter thesis, or vice-versa. The system must flexibly support paper-only, journal-only, or dual-file bundles without dropping OCR metadata extraction.
runbook.prevention: Ensure server upload middleware and client file pickers validate at least one valid PDF is present rather than enforcing all document slots, and ensure per-field rescan buttons check hasDocumentForRescan (either file) rather than hardcoded to paper only.
